subject: Staircase commit path & renewal-trigger MAP — Olive AI discussion
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Peter Garrett <peter.garrett@oliveai.com>
Cc: Olive AI Procurement <procurement@oliveai.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Draft MAP + staircase commit proposal (POC -> First Renewal)

Hi Peter,

Thanks again for the conversation earlier this week. Per our call I attached a first-pass Mutual Action Plan that maps the evaluation milestones to committed tiers and the renewal uplift mechanics. High level:

- 0–6 weeks: POC (success criteria: 5 canonical flows instrumented, avg latency < 300ms, precision > 92% on test set) — no initial commit, Redwood provides sandbox credits.
- Month 2–4: Pilot ramp to 50k tokens/day — recommended minimum commit: $15k/month; if commit executed within agreed window, 10% usage discount applies starting month 4.
- Month 5–12: Production ramp to target throughput (100k tokens/day) — full commit: $45k/month; on renewal, if adoption metrics are met (see MAP section 4), customer receives a renewal uplift discount staircase (10% additional credit for year 2 baseline uplift, 5% retro for any month-over-month usage growth >20%).

Proposed next steps:
1) You confirm the POC success criteria and the two-stage commit thresholds.
2) Procurement confirms the acceptable billing cadence and any legal redline items.
3) We send an SOW and DocuSign for the pilot commit clause once terms are agreed.

I've attached the MAP draft (Redwood_MAP_v1.pdf) with the timeline and the metrics table. If those milestones look reasonable I can loop in finance/legal for a conditional discount approval and return an updated SOW.

Thanks,
Priyom
---
Priyom Das

Subject: Re: Draft MAP + staircase commit proposal (POC -> First Renewal)

Peter — great questions. Level-setting answers below and an updated MAP summary inline.

1) Renewal uplift mechanics (short):
   - Discounts are off-invoice percentage applied to committed monthly usage.
   - Staircase example: initial pilot commit (months 2–4) gets 10% off-invoice discount; upon reaching production commit (months 5–12) the base discount moves to 15%. At renewal evaluation, if adoption metrics exceed thresholds (DAU increase >25% vs pilot baseline and sustained avg tokens/day > target for 3 consecutive months), we apply an additional 5% renewal uplift discount to the Year 2 committed baseline.

2) Data residency: Redwood will host evaluation logs and KV cache in the EU region for the POC. Retention defaults to 30 days for debug logs; customer can request extended retention via an Addendum (we'll document in SOW).

3) SOW & pilot clause: SOW will include a 30-day opt-out following pilot sign-off and an explicit timeline for when pilot spend converts to committed credits. I'll attach a cleaner SOW draft and include the ring-fenced pilot wording.

Updated MAP (high level):
- Dec 1–Dec 30: EU POC (instrumentation + residency confirmation)
- Jan 1–Mar 31: Pilot ramp (50k tokens/day target) — optional pilot commit window triggers 10% off-invoice discount when paid within 30 days of invoice.
- Apr 1–Dec 31: Production commit period — full commit and baseline for renewal assessment.

Next: I will loop in Finance/Legal for a conditional approval of the staircase discounts so we have something to hand to procurement.

I'll also push an updated SOW to the HubSpot deal (link below).

HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/DEAL-2026-OLIVE-317

Best,
Priyom
[Attachment: SOW_Olive_Redwood_v0.9.pdf (27 KB)]

Subject: Internal: pricing approval request — Olive AI MAP discount staircase (DEAL-2026-OLIVE-317)

Team — looping you in to get a quick decision on the conditional discounts for Olive. Key asks:

- Approve two-stage discount ladder: 10% pilot discount (months 2–4) and 15% production discount (months 5–12).
- Contingent renewal uplift: additional 5% if adoption metrics are met at renewal.
- Approve EU data-residency addendum for POC logs (30-day retention by default).

Rationale: Olive is strategic in healthcare verticals; if we secure a contract that moves them to production and reaches 100k tokens/day we get significant reference value and predictable committed spend. Risk: discount leakage if adoption metrics are not validated.

Attachments: Redwood_MAP_v1.pdf (proposal), SOW_Olive_Redwood_v0.9.pdf (SOW draft).

Can you confirm approvals or required redlines by EOD tomorrow so we can keep procurement on a single review cycle?

—Priyom

Subject: Re: Internal: pricing approval request — Olive AI MAP discount staircase (DEAL-2026-OLIVE-317)

Priyom — I reviewed the tiered discounts. Approve conditionally with the following redlines:

1) Add a usage reconciliation clause at the end of months 3 and 6 — if usage deviates >15% from reported tokens, we reserve the right to reclaim excess credits or true-up the commitment.
2) Renewal uplift only applies if all three adoption metrics are met (DAU growth, sustained avg tokens/day, and business impact sign-off from Olive Product).
3) Pilot discount requires payment within 20 days (shorter than proposed) to prevent extended receivable risk.

I'll attach marked redlines. Finance signs off on the 15% production discount but wants the reconciliation clause added.

Marissa
